claims.statement: Jem Mace wrote that he beat Tom Allen at New Orleans in 1870.
claims.excerpt: you neg'all yikes ay Tom Allen at New Orleaps in

fights.excerpt: you neg'all yikes ay Tom Allen at New Orleaps in
fights.notes: Known only from Mace's letter quoted in 1883. The line is badly garbled; the year is printed 'is70'. Result read as a loss for Allen from 'beat'.

notes: Mace's letter is the only source. The words before 'Tom Allen' are garbled, so the exact wording is uncertain.
